ns2:section.sectionText: Field trip is not required for online section. Online scheduled class sessions require each student to have high speed internet access and either a headset with a microphone or an external microphone and speakers so they may participate in the class discussions. Wireless internet is not recommended. The class will meet Mondays August 26 through December 9, except there will be NO class on September 2 and 9. Online & Continuing Education (OCE) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.oce.illinois.edu.
